name: Activity
author: Brett
description: A banner at the top of the console whenever anything is in progress: GitHub Actions runs on your repos, the console's own update, AI assistant replies, VPS Auto fix jobs, Claude Code sessions on the VPS (after one hook install) and anything else that reports itself. Tap it to see every item; tap an item for its details: what it's doing, its steps (GitHub jobs and steps included), how long it's taken, who started it and a link. When everything finishes it says so, then goes away.
